A security flaw has been discovered in Linux Foundation Magma up to 1.9.0. The affected element is an unknown function of the file orc8r/lib/go/registry/interceptors.go. The manipulation results in race condition. The attack may be performed from remote. Attacks of this nature are highly complex. It is stated that the exploitability is difficult. The exploit has been made public and could be used. Upgrading to version 0.32.0 is able to resolve this issue. The patch is identified as e687a251bb056fa527846633f7a1b0a6c0f42374.
